title: Does Sybil use CT-defined emphysema geometry?
question: For one frozen Sybil risk horizon, does a validated within-image edit that removes or inserts spatially coherent CT-emphysema clusters change the risk score more than equal-dose normal-parenchyma sham and diffuse-density edits?
deliverable_sentence: Conditional on passing the edit-validity gate and the prespecified positive pattern: Sybil is using CT-defined emphysema — spatially coherent lung regions below -950 HU — as part of its lung-cancer risk score.
why_it_matters: Sybil predicts future lung cancer even when no cancer nodule is visible at the future cancer site. Identifying a named, independently measurable parenchymal cue would make part of that residual signal legible to radiologists; showing that the apparent effect is only an edit artifact would prevent an unsupported explanation from hardening into fact.

claim_boundaries.claimed_if_positive: Use of the spatially coherent CT-emphysema signal by one prespecified Sybil output in the tested held-out NLST cohort.
not_claimed: That CT emphysema is the only non-nodular signal Sybil uses.
That the edit recreates or reverses alveolar destruction biologically.
That quantitative emphysema mediates Sybil's cancer prediction or should change patient management.
That an observational score-emphysema association establishes model use.
That the result generalizes across scanners, sites, kernels, populations, or Sybil horizons not tested.

rung.why: No model-use experiment has yet been run. The proposed controlled perturbation can reach rung 1, its paired identity controls address major artifact classes for rung 2, and X already has a named radiological interpretation for rung 3; none is earned until the validity and result gates pass.
rung.what_would_move_it_up: First pass the held-out edit-validity gate. Then show a directional, dose-responsive, reciprocal score effect for coherent clusters that exceeds both the normal-tissue sham and equal-HU diffuse control while protected anatomy and acquisition variables remain unchanged.

X_measurement.X: CT-defined emphysema geometry: connected, spatially coherent lung-parenchyma clusters with attenuation below -950 HU on inspiratory CT. Cluster burden and size distribution are primary descriptors; isolated sub-threshold voxels are excluded from X and reported as a noise control.
X_measurement.how: Use an automatic lung mask, exclude automatically segmented vessels, airways, airway walls, and detector-identified nodules, threshold remaining parenchyma at -950 HU, and compute connected components, burden, and cluster-size statistics. No radiologist annotation is required.
citations: Gevenois PA et al., Am J Respir Crit Care Med 1995;152:653-657, PMID 7633722, DOI 10.1164/ajrccm.152.2.7633722
Hansell DM et al., Radiology 2008;246:697-722, PMID 18195376, DOI 10.1148/radiol.2462070712
Nambu A et al., Korean J Radiol 2018;19:139-146, PMID 29354010, DOI 10.3348/kjr.2018.19.1.139
X_measurement.could_I_compute_it_today_without_asking_: Yes. X is a calibrated voxel threshold plus connected-component measurement inside automatic masks. Tool performance and QC on NLST remain feasibility checks, but no human concept label is needed.

keystone_prerequisite: The exact tissue-for-tissue edit can alter coherent <-950 HU cluster geometry while remaining in-distribution for frozen Sybil and without changing protected airway, vessel, nodule, lung-volume, reconstruction, dose, habitus, or framing signals enough to explain the score response.
keystone_evidence: No implementation or held-out validation of this operator has been inspected. S(H)NAP demonstrates that generative chest-CT nodule edits can appear realistic, but it used a different target and operator and therefore does not validate parenchymal substitution for Sybil.
keystone_residual_assumption: If I have only verified the nearest checkable thing, what am I still assuming? Verifying that CT emphysema is automatically measurable, or that another chest-CT editor produced plausible nodule images, still assumes that this particular parenchymal edit is locally realistic and invisible to Sybil as an operation. That is load-bearing and is the real keystone.

stage_0_gate.timing: Freeze the held-out cases, operator, edit doses, protected masks, tolerances, discriminator procedure, sham-effect tolerance, and go/no-go rules before examining Sybil responses to targeted edits.
inspect: Whether obtainable held-out NLST series link to the published Sybil test population and provide enough fixed-kernel high- and low-emphysema hosts.
Whether automatic lung, airway, vessel, airway-wall, and nodule masks run with prespecified QC and without human adjudication.
Whether edited and unedited images satisfy frozen low-level, anatomical-summary, boundary, spectrum, crop, and framing tolerances.
Whether a held-out edit discriminator and the dose-matched normal-parenchyma sham remain below prespecified failure thresholds.
stage_0_gate.decision: GO only if every validity threshold passes. If the discriminator or sham indicates a detectable operation signature, stop: the intervention is void and no model-use conclusion is allowed.

dies_like_prior: The live risk is idea 006's intervention-validity failure: a score can respond to an out-of-distribution edit rather than to X. This candidate differs only conditionally, by using local tissue-for-tissue substitution, reciprocal edits, an equal-operation sham, an equal-HU form control, protected anatomy, and a prospective validity gate; until that gate passes it is not exempt from the same death. It does not share the annotation-provenance failures of ideas 001, 002, 003, or 005 because X and the primary endpoint require no human concept labels. It also avoids idea 008's superseded reconstruction error: reconstruction is fixed and no kernel contrast is treated as biological variation.

closest_prior_work.citation: Sobieski B et al., Auditing Sybil: Explaining Deep Lung Cancer Risk Prediction Through Generative Interventional Attributions, arXiv:2602.02560
closest_prior_work.delta: It intervened on nodules, isolated a background term, and mentioned emphysema as an intuition; it did not measure or intervene on quantitative emphysema. Its editor does not establish validity of the proposed operator.

closest_prior_work.citation: Mikhael PG et al., J Clin Oncol 2023;41:2191-2200, PMID 36634294, DOI 10.1200/JCO.22.01345
closest_prior_work.delta: It established residual predictive performance after excluding visible cancer nodules at the future cancer location, but did not identify a named parenchymal cue.

closest_prior_work.citation: Simon J et al., Invest Radiol 2024, PMID 39437009, DOI 10.1097/RLI.0000000000001131
closest_prior_work.delta: It tested Sybil across reconstruction changes, not use of biological emphysema; that reconstruction audit is explicitly outside this candidate.

novelty_statement: No novelty claim is made. Inspected close work leaves this exact intervention unanswered, but conference and later-literature overlap must be searched in primary sources before describing it as novel.

smallest_decisive_experiment.prerequisite: On a frozen, held-out, single-kernel cohort, confirm a prespecified score association with coherent cluster burden only to justify effect sizing and host selection. This association is not evidence of use and is not the confirmatory result.
smallest_decisive_experiment.confirmatory_endpoint: Within-image change in one frozen Sybil horizon per unit edited coherent-cluster burden, contrasted against the paired equal-voxel normal-parenchyma sham and equal-total-HU diffuse-density control.
smallest_decisive_experiment.design: Apply one controlled edit family at frozen graded doses. In high-emphysema scans, replace coherent clusters with patient-matched normal parenchyma; in low-emphysema hosts, insert matched coherent clusters. For each targeted edit, generate a normal-to-normal sham with the same voxel count, boundary handling, and interpolation, plus a diffuse edit with the same voxel count and total HU deficit but no coherent geometry. Preserve protected anatomy by identity. Use patient-level paired estimation and an untouched test set.
smallest_decisive_experiment.positive_pattern: Removal decreases and insertion increases the fixed Sybil score; effects are monotone with dose, reverse direction across removal and insertion, exceed the sham tolerance, and are larger for coherent than equal-HU diffuse edits. All validity and anatomy-preservation gates must pass.
smallest_decisive_experiment.negative_interpretation: If confidence intervals exclude the preregistered minimum effect for the coherent-versus-sham and coherent-versus-diffuse contrasts in both directions after the validity gate passes, the result decisively weakens material use of this X by the tested output. Ordinary non-significance is sensitivity-limited. Failure of the validity gate is an operator-feasibility result, not a negative about Sybil.

claim_identifiability.scanner_vendor_site_protocol_reconstruct: Held constant within each image. They may modify generalizability but cannot explain a targeted-versus-control difference on the identical host if the editor itself is valid.
claim_identifiability.label_leakage: No report, outcome, or human concept label enters X or the paired endpoint. Held-out status is still required to avoid training-case memorization.
claim_identifiability.image_noise_and_generic_HU_response: The normal-tissue sham matches operation dose; the diffuse control matches voxel count and total HU deficit. Isolated low-attenuation voxels are measured separately. These controls distinguish coherent geometry from a generic edit or density response only if their construction passes Stage 0.
claim_identifiability.airway_vascular_nodule_signals: Their voxels are protected by identity and their automatic summaries must remain within frozen tolerances. Segmentation omissions remain a residual threat.
claim_identifiability.preprocessing_framing: The final model tensor, crop, padding, and physical scale are compared before and after every edit; failure voids the pair.
claim_identifiability.remaining_alternative: Sybil may respond to an unmeasured texture changed together with coherent low attenuation, or to a subtle editor signature undetected by the chosen diagnostics. The result identifies the declared CT-emphysema signal at the resolution of the controlled edit, not microscopic alveolar destruction.

anticipated_negative.classification: decisive only under equivalence and a passed validity gate
anticipated_negative.meaningful_negative: Tight confidence bounds excluding the prespecified minimum coherent-geometry effect in both removal and insertion, while shams and validity checks pass, would decisively weaken material use of CT-defined emphysema geometry by the tested Sybil output.
anticipated_negative.non_decisive_negative: A wide interval, lack of observational host overlap, segmentation failure, or edit-validity failure is sensitivity- or feasibility-limited and says nothing about whether Sybil uses X.

data_and_compute.data: Candidate source is held-out NLST imaging through TCIA/IDC. Actual identifier linkage, fixed-kernel overlap, and public covariate availability remain uninspected go/no-go facts; the study must not depend on unconfirmed gated data.
data_and_compute.model: Released Sybil code and checkpoint described by Mikhael et al.; pin the exact checkpoint, preprocessing, horizon, and checksum before analysis.
data_and_compute.compute: Operator validation and inference on a prespecified subset are intended for single-GPU sessions. Feasibility depends more on data transfer and edit validation than on model training; no model training is proposed.

remaining_legwork: Directly parse and join the actual Sybil split identifiers to obtainable NLST series; reconcile published cohort counts and tabulate fixed-kernel host overlap.
Define numeric edit-validity, anatomy-preservation, discriminator, sham, equivalence, and minimum-effect thresholds before score inspection.
Select and validate the automatic masks and nodule detector on held-out NLST without a radiologist adjudication dependency.
Specify the tissue donor matching, boundary treatment, dose grid, and reciprocal insertion rules without writing probe code.
Complete a primary-source overlap search, including conference proceedings, before any novelty statement.
Only after a reviewed feasibility memo, probe contract, and explicit human approval may probe code be written.

clarity.why: One frozen output, one named X, and one controlled bidirectional edit contrast with explicit controls.

identifiability.why: Paired host identity, reciprocal direction, sham, and equal-HU form control address the main alternatives, but edit realism and unmeasured co-edited texture remain unresolved.

medical_relevance.why: A named explanation for Sybil's residual signal would improve interpretation of a lung-cancer risk model, though it does not itself establish clinical utility.

interest.why: It directly tests an explanation suggested but not measured in close Sybil work; the result is useful in either direction if the validity gate passes.

prior_legwork.why: The model, public imaging route, quantitative CT definition, residual-signal result, and close interventional precedent exist; the actual operator and cohort join do not.

feasibility.why: Capped by the NOT_INSPECTED keystone and reduced further because constructing and validating a credible reciprocal tissue editor is a substantial unresolved barrier.

data_readiness.why: NLST imaging and Sybil assets are described as obtainable, but the exact held-out join, fixed-kernel overlap, and host counts have not been directly established.

evaluation_readiness.why: Paired contrasts are standard, but defensible edit-validity thresholds, equivalence margins, and operator diagnostics still require prospective definition.

negative_result_value.why: A powered equivalence result after a passed validity gate is decisive for this X and output; many likely failures would instead be feasibility-limited.

novelty_confidence.why: Capped by the NOT_INSPECTED keystone. Close primary work leaves the question open, but the broader primary-source overlap audit is incomplete.

regret.why: The scientific question is strong, but the operator-validity burden makes this no longer a low-hanging experiment.

recommendation: REVISE COMPLETE; proceed only to a feasibility memo and explicit Stage 0 specification. No probe code is authorized.
